Stop 1 — Kingston Road
Kingston Avenue of Honour
▲

286 Dutch Elm trees planted in August 1918 by the communities of the former Shire of Creswick, each commemorating a man or woman who served in the Great War. The Avenue stretches 2.9km along Kingston Road.
